005package org.wpilib.command2.button;
006
007import static org.wpilib.util.ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam;
008
009import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
010import org.wpilib.command2.Command;
011import org.wpilib.command2.CommandScheduler;
012import org.wpilib.event.EventLoop;
013import org.wpilib.math.filter.Debouncer;
014import org.wpilib.math.filter.EdgeCounterFilter;
015
016/**
017 * This class provides an easy way to link commands to conditions.
018 *
019 * <p>It is very easy to link a button to a command. For instance, you could link the trigger button
020 * of a joystick to a "score" command.
021 *
022 * <p>Triggers can easily be composed for advanced functionality using the {@link
023 * #and(BooleanSupplier)}, {@link #or(BooleanSupplier)}, {@link #negate()} operators.
024 *
025 * <table>
026 * <caption>Positive trigger command bindings</caption>
027 * <tr>
028 * <th>Method</th>
029 * <th>Schedules</th>
030 * <th>Cancels on false</th>
031 * </tr>
032 * <tr>
033 * <td>{@link #onTrue(Command)}</td>
034 * <td>On a rising edge</td>
035 * <td>No</td>
036 * </tr>
037 * <tr>
038 * <td>{@link #ifTrue(Command)}</td>
039 * <td>On every true poll</td>
040 * <td>No</td>
041 * </tr>
042 * <tr>
043 * <td>{@link #whileTrue(Command)}</td>
044 * <td>On a rising edge</td>
045 * <td>Yes</td>
046 * </tr>
047 * </table>
048 *
049 * <p>This class is provided by the Commands v2 VendorDep
050 */
051public class Trigger implements BooleanSupplier {
052  /** Functional interface for the body of a trigger binding. */
053  @FunctionalInterface
054  private interface BindingBody {
055    /**
056     * Executes the body of the binding.
057     *
058     * @param previous The previous state of the condition.
059     * @param current The current state of the condition.
060     */
061    void run(boolean previous, boolean current);
062  }
063
064  private final BooleanSupplier m_condition;
065  private final EventLoop m_loop;
066
067  /**
068   * Creates a new trigger based on the given condition.
069   *
070   * @param loop The loop instance that polls this trigger.
071   * @param condition the condition represented by this trigger
072   */
073  public Trigger(EventLoop loop, BooleanSupplier condition) {
074    m_loop = requireNonNullParam(loop, "loop", "Trigger");
075    m_condition = requireNonNullParam(condition, "condition", "Trigger");
076  }
077
078  /**
079   * Creates a new trigger based on the given condition.
080   *
081   * <p>Polled by the default scheduler button loop.
082   *
083   * @param condition the condition represented by this trigger
084   */
085  public Trigger(BooleanSupplier condition) {
086    this(CommandScheduler.getInstance().getDefaultButtonLoop(), condition);
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * Adds a binding to the EventLoop.
091   *
092   * @param body The body of the binding to add.
093   */
094  private void addBinding(BindingBody body) {
095    m_loop.bind(
096        new Runnable() {
097          private boolean m_previous = m_condition.getAsBoolean();
098
099          @Override
100          public void run() {
101            boolean current = m_condition.getAsBoolean();
102
103            body.run(m_previous, current);
104
105            m_previous = current;
106          }
107        });
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * Starts the command when the condition changes.
112   *
113   * @param command the command to start
114   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
115   */
116  public Trigger onChange(Command command) {
117    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "onChange");
118    addBinding(
119        (previous, current) -> {
120          if (previous != current) {
121            CommandScheduler.getInstance().schedule(command);
122          }
123        });
124    return this;
125  }
126
127  /**
128   * Starts the given command whenever the condition changes from `false` to `true`.
129   *
130   * @param command the command to start
131   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
132   */
133  public Trigger onTrue(Command command) {
134    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "onTrue");
135    addBinding(
136        (previous, current) -> {
137          if (!previous && current) {
138            CommandScheduler.getInstance().schedule(command);
139          }
140        });
141    return this;
142  }
143
144  /**
145   * Starts the given command on every event-loop poll where the condition is {@code true}.
146   *
147   * <p>This does not cancel the command when the condition becomes {@code false}; use {@link
148   * #whileTrue(Command)} for that behavior. Scheduling an already-running command follows ordinary
149   * scheduler behavior and does not restart it.
150   *
151   * @param command the command to start
152   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
153   */
154  public Trigger ifTrue(Command command) {
155    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "ifTrue");
156    addBinding(
157        (previous, current) -> {
158          if (current) {
159            CommandScheduler.getInstance().schedule(command);
160          }
161        });
162    return this;
163  }
164
165  /**
166   * Starts the given command whenever the condition changes from `true` to `false`.
167   *
168   * @param command the command to start
169   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
170   */
171  public Trigger onFalse(Command command) {
172    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "onFalse");
173    addBinding(
174        (previous, current) -> {
175          if (previous && !current) {
176            CommandScheduler.getInstance().schedule(command);
177          }
178        });
179    return this;
180  }
181
182  /**
183   * Starts the given command when the condition changes to `true` and cancels it when the condition
184   * changes to `false`.
185   *
186   * <p>Doesn't re-start the command if it ends while the condition is still `true`. If the command
187   * should restart, see {@link org.wpilib.command2.RepeatCommand}.
188   *
189   * @param command the command to start
190   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
191   */
192  public Trigger whileTrue(Command command) {
193    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "whileTrue");
194    addBinding(
195        (previous, current) -> {
196          if (!previous && current) {
197            CommandScheduler.getInstance().schedule(command);
198          } else if (previous && !current) {
199            command.cancel();
200          }
201        });
202    return this;
203  }
204
205  /**
206   * Starts the given command when the condition changes to `false` and cancels it when the
207   * condition changes to `true`.
208   *
209   * <p>Doesn't re-start the command if it ends while the condition is still `false`. If the command
210   * should restart, see {@link org.wpilib.command2.RepeatCommand}.
211   *
212   * @param command the command to start
213   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
214   */
215  public Trigger whileFalse(Command command) {
216    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "whileFalse");
217    addBinding(
218        (previous, current) -> {
219          if (previous && !current) {
220            CommandScheduler.getInstance().schedule(command);
221          } else if (!previous && current) {
222            command.cancel();
223          }
224        });
225    return this;
226  }
227
228  /**
229   * Toggles a command when the condition changes from `false` to `true`.
230   *
231   * @param command the command to toggle
232   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
233   */
234  public Trigger toggleOnTrue(Command command) {
235    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "toggleOnTrue");
236    addBinding(
237        (previous, current) -> {
238          if (!previous && current) {
239            if (command.isScheduled()) {
240              command.cancel();
241            } else {
242              CommandScheduler.getInstance().schedule(command);
243            }
244          }
245        });
246    return this;
247  }
248
249  /**
250   * Toggles a command when the condition changes from `true` to `false`.
251   *
252   * @param command the command to toggle
253   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
254   */
255  public Trigger toggleOnFalse(Command command) {
256    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "toggleOnFalse");
257    addBinding(
258        (previous, current) -> {
259          if (previous && !current) {
260            if (command.isScheduled()) {
261              command.cancel();
262            } else {
263              CommandScheduler.getInstance().schedule(command);
264            }
265          }
266        });
267    return this;
268  }
269
270  @Override
271  public boolean getAsBoolean() {
272    return m_condition.getAsBoolean();
273  }
274
275  /**
276   * Composes two triggers with logical AND.
277   *
278   * @param trigger the condition to compose with
279   * @return A trigger which is active when both component triggers are active.
280   */
281  public Trigger and(BooleanSupplier trigger) {
282    return new Trigger(m_loop, () -> m_condition.getAsBoolean() && trigger.getAsBoolean());
283  }
284
285  /**
286   * Composes two triggers with logical OR.
287   *
288   * @param trigger the condition to compose with
289   * @return A trigger which is active when either component trigger is active.
290   */
291  public Trigger or(BooleanSupplier trigger) {
292    return new Trigger(m_loop, () -> m_condition.getAsBoolean() || trigger.getAsBoolean());
293  }
294
295  /**
296   * Creates a new trigger that is active when this trigger is inactive, i.e. that acts as the
297   * negation of this trigger.
298   *
299   * @return the negated trigger
300   */
301  public Trigger negate() {
302    return new Trigger(m_loop, () -> !m_condition.getAsBoolean());
303  }
304
305  /**
306   * Creates a new debounced trigger from this trigger - it will become active when this trigger has
307   * been active for longer than the specified period.
308   *
309   * @param seconds The debounce period.
310   * @return The debounced trigger (rising edges debounced only)
311   */
312  public Trigger debounce(double seconds) {
313    return debounce(seconds, Debouncer.DebounceType.RISING);
314  }
315
316  /**
317   * Creates a new debounced trigger from this trigger - it will become active when this trigger has
318   * been active for longer than the specified period.
319   *
320   * @param seconds The debounce period.
321   * @param type The debounce type.
322   * @return The debounced trigger.
323   */
324  public Trigger debounce(double seconds, Debouncer.DebounceType type) {
325    return new Trigger(
326        m_loop,
327        new BooleanSupplier() {
328          final Debouncer m_debouncer = new Debouncer(seconds, type);
329
330          @Override
331          public boolean getAsBoolean() {
332            return m_debouncer.calculate(m_condition.getAsBoolean());
333          }
334        });
335  }
336
337  /**
338   * Creates a new multi-press trigger from this trigger - it will become active when this trigger
339   * has been activated the required number of times within the specified time window.
340   *
341   * <p>This is useful for implementing "double-click" style functionality.
342   *
343   * <p>Input for this must be stable, consider using a Debouncer before this to avoid counting
344   * noise as multiple presses.
345   *
346   * @param requiredPresses The number of presses required.
347   * @param windowTime The number of seconds in which the presses must occur.
348   * @return The multi-press trigger.
349   */
350  public Trigger multiPress(int requiredPresses, double windowTime) {
351    return new Trigger(
352        m_loop,
353        new BooleanSupplier() {
354          final EdgeCounterFilter m_edgeCounterFilter =
355              new EdgeCounterFilter(requiredPresses, windowTime);
356
357          @Override
358          public boolean getAsBoolean() {
359            return m_edgeCounterFilter.calculate(m_condition.getAsBoolean());
360          }
361        });
362  }
363}
